title: PackItems

PackItems brings custom items to life on your server by turning simple YAML definitions into fully interactive weapons, tools, and special items. It handles the hard parts for you: custom models, textures, resource pack generation, pack delivery, and item behavior, so players can just join and start using everything right away.

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93ba79511c755ed5da946ddcc4c19ef4ff764712.png)

## Overview

PackItems is made for servers that want custom content to feel native instead of clunky or manually managed. It creates a smooth experience for players by automatically sending the required resource pack, applying the right item visuals, and connecting those items to in-game actions that actually matter.

The goal is simple: give your server polished custom items without making players jump through setup hoops. Whether you want RPG weapons, ability-based tools, special utility items, or seasonal content, PackItems keeps the whole flow seamless from join to gameplay.

## What it does

PackItems takes a custom item folder and turns it into a fully working in-game item with its own look and behavior. You can define the item’s material, appearance, stack rules, enchantments, attributes, cooldowns, and reactions to player actions, then let the plugin handle the rest automatically.

It supports:
- Custom item models and textures
- Automatic resource pack generation
- Built-in pack hosting and delivery
- Force pack behavior on join
- Custom cooldowns and item effects
- Sounds, particles, commands, and potion effects
- Special attributes, enchantments, and stack sizes
- TextAPI formatted names and lore
- Item reactions to clicks, combat, movement, blocks, and death events

The result is a system that makes custom items feel like real gameplay features, not just cosmetic overrides.

## Player experience

From a player’s point of view, PackItems is meant to be invisible in all the right ways. They join the server, receive the pack if needed, and instantly see and use the custom content without manual downloads or extra setup.

That means the focus stays on the fun part: using the item. A sword can trigger a special attack, a tool can play effects when used, and a gadget can react to movement or combat in a way that feels custom-built for the server.

## How it feels in game

PackItems is designed to make each item feel distinct and memorable. A custom weapon can show its own name, lore, model, and visual effects, while also responding to actions like right-clicking, hitting entities, jumping, or breaking blocks.

It also supports polished gameplay feedback through cooldown indicators, particles, sounds, potion effects, and chat messages. That makes custom items easier to understand for players and more satisfying to use during actual gameplay.

## Best use cases

PackItems fits servers that want custom content with a strong player-facing identity. It works especially well for:
- RPG servers with special weapons and abilities
- Survival servers with custom tools and progression
- Minigames with unique gadgets and effects
- Seasonal or event-based content
- Servers that want a clean, automatic resource pack flow

If your goal is to make players notice the item, use it naturally, and enjoy it immediately, PackItems is built for that.

## Compatibility

PackItems is built for:
- Spigot 1.21+
- Paper 1.21+
- Java 21+
- Kotlin 2.4+
- TextAPI integration

## Summary

PackItems is a custom item plugin that makes server content feel alive. It combines automatic resource pack delivery, rich item visuals, and trigger-based gameplay effects into one smooth experience that players can just log into and use.
